about: Each name-check finding at the recorded OpenTitan revision, classified by reading the sentence and the register description. on_master: whether the same check still finds it on OpenTitan's master branch (commit 80db19f, November 16, 2026).

alert_handler:field:CLASSA_CTRL_SHADOWED.note: CLASSA_CTRL_SHADOWED has no REGWEN field; the class lock is the CLASSA_REGWEN register

aon_timer:link:WKUP_THOLD_HI.note: bits 31:0 are in WKUP_THOLD_LO, where the link goes; the text names WKUP_THOLD_HI

ascon:field:OUTPUT_VALID.data_type.note: OUTPUT_VALID has MSG_VALID, TAG_VALID and TAG_COMPARISON_VALID; there is no data_type field

clkmgr:target:IO_MEASURE_CTRL.note: the registers are IO_MEAS_CTRL_EN and IO_MEAS_CTRL_SHADOWED; corrected in PR #32162

csrng:field:CTRL.WRITE_INT_STATE.note: not in the description at this revision; on master the design has it

csrng:field:RECOV_ALERT_STS.INT_STATE_OV.note: not in the description at this revision; on master the design has it

csrng:target:INT_STATE_WRITE_ENABLE.note: not in the description at this revision; on master the design has it

csrng:target:INT_STATE_WRITE_ENABLE_REGW.note: not in the description at this revision; on master the design has it

flash_ctrl:field:ERR_CODE.PROG_INTG_ERR.note: ERR_CODE has no PROG_INTG_ERR; the field is in STD_FAULT_STATUS

flash_ctrl:field:FAULT_STATUS.LCMGR_INTG.note: FAULT_STATUS has no LCMGR_INTG_ERR; the field is in STD_FAULT_STATUS

flash_ctrl:field:FAULT_STATUS.PROG_INTG_.note: FAULT_STATUS has no PROG_INTG_ERR; the field is in STD_FAULT_STATUS

i2c:field:FIFO_CTRL.FMTILVL.note: FIFO_CTRL has no FMTILVL; the format FIFO threshold is HOST_FIFO_CONFIG.FMT_THRESH

keymgr_dpe:field:CONTROL_SHADOWED.DST_SE.note: the field that selects AES, KMAC, OTBN or HMAC is DEST_SEL

kmac:field:CMD.mode.note: CMD has no mode field; the mode is CFG_SHADOWED.mode

lc_ctrl:field:TRANSITION_CTRL.EXT_CLK_EN.note: the field is EXT_CLOCK_EN (the link already goes to it)

otbn:field:CMD.start.note: CMD has a single field, cmd; an operation starts when the EXECUTE command (0xd8) is written

otp_ctrl:target:CREATOR_SW_CFG.note: an OTP partition, not a register; corrected in PR #32162

otp_ctrl:target:HW_CFG_DIGEST_0.note: the registers are HW_CFG0_DIGEST_0 and HW_CFG1_DIGEST_0; corrected in PR #32162

otp_ctrl:target:OWNER_SW_CFG.note: an OTP partition, not a register; corrected in PR #32162

pattgen:field:CTRL.ENABLE.note: one ENABLE_CHn field per channel; the sentence says "for the desired channel"

pattgen:field:CTRL.INACTIVE_LEVEL_PCL.note: one field per channel; the sentence says so

pattgen:field:CTRL.INACTIVE_LEVEL_PDA.note: one field per channel; the sentence says so

pinmux:target:PERIPH_INSEL_0.note: the register is MIO_PERIPH_INSEL_0; corrected in PR #32162

rram_ctrl:field:EXEC.CONFIG.note: EXEC.CONFIG.REDUN names a security countermeasure, linked to interfaces.md

rv_plic:target:IE0.note: the registers are IE0_0, IE0_1, ...; the entries are #ie0_0, ...

rv_plic:target:IP.note: the registers are IP_0, IP_1, ...; the entries are #ip_0, ...

rv_plic:target:PRIO0.note: the register is PRIO_0; the entry is #prio

rv_plic:target:PRIO31.note: the register is PRIO_31; the link goes to #prio_1, and the entry is #prio

spi_device:target:FILTER.note: there is no FILTER register; the command filter registers are CMD_FILTER_0, CMD_FILTER_1, ...

spi_host:field:ERROR_STATUS.CMDERR.note: the field for a command written when not ready is CMDBUSY

sysrst_ctrl:target:COM_DET_SEL_CTL_0.note: there is no COM_DET_SEL_CTL_0; the pre-condition time is set in COM_PRE_DET_CTL_0

uart:field:STATUS.BREAK.note: STATUS has no break bit: the documented way to read the current break status does not exist
